items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
2 - 4 years of related experience.
Experience working with diverse clientele in a higher education institution.

Experience in research and laboratory-based operations, with comprehensive understanding of complex mandates governing the procurement of controlled substances and other hazardous chemicals and materials.
Experience in using UC online systems.

Drafts and executes purchase orders, utilizing standard terms and conditions for materials, supplies, equipment, and services. Drafts Request for Quotations (RFQs) including specifications and terms and conditions. (30% time)

Regularly communicates with organization's customers, reduces risk to the University by ensuring departmental compliance with procurement policy, and works in conjunction with end-users to develop specifications for RFQs. (10% time)

Review and reconcile purchase orders that have posted to UC Oracle and review encumbrance balance report to reconcile open encumbrances for release and appropriateness through UC Oracle. In conjunction with accounting assistant, serve as liaison, with Accounts Payable. Take lead on researching issues on large dollar items. (10% time)

Dept Equipment Manager; Manage the tagging, selling, loaning, transferring, and disposing of the department's equipment items including donated and fabricated units. As part of the annual inventory check, ensure the accuracy and completeness of equipment records in the Asset Management System; maintain accurate count, location, ownership and usage status of the department's equipment inventory list by updating the AMS as changes occur. Keep faculty and researchers informed about the rules involving the disposition of any equipment or unwanted items. (10% time)
Develops spreadsheets and other documentation to support analysis. (5% time)
Negotiates with suppliers for lower prices and better terms and helps resolve supplier performance issues. (5% time)
Interprets and applies basic University policies and procedures. (5% time)
Performs cost analyses and reviews terms and conditions for appropriateness. Makes awards based on cost and specification requirements. (5% time)
Under general supervision, provides analysis of moderate purchasing projects. (5% time)
Acquires and maintains a basic technical understanding of commonly purchased products. (5% time)
Participates in professional development and training. (5% time)
Maintain a complete and accurate desk reference manual (i.e. departmental Quick Reference Guides). (5% time)

Analytical skills necessary to evaluate the quality and cost effectiveness of purchasing options.
Understands ERP/financial systems (such as Oracle, PeopleSoft, SAP, Banner, etc.).
Ability to communicate effectively in writing and verbally.
Demonstrated knowledge of UC Purchasing policies and procedures.
Ability to read and interpret terms and conditions of basic contracts.
Demonstrated knowledge of equipment inventory procedures.
Some knowledge of the organization's departments and operations required in order to meet their procurement needs.
Working level of proficiency in the use of standard spreadsheet and word processing software.
Ability to research and analyze information to formulate and implement solutions to problems.
